description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Corporate counsel at Alan

As Senior Corporate Counsel, you are part of the legal engine behind Alan's most strategic corporate projects — M&A, restructuring, financing, international expansion, governance and tax. You own them end to end, from first negotiation to signed documents, with the drive to get them over the line.

This is a hands-on, operational role: you don't advise from the sidelines, you lead, you build, and you automate to scale legal operations. We're looking for top-tier technical skills combined with the creativity and pragmatism to find solutions that actually work for the business.

Missions

As Senior Corporate Counsel, you will contribute to a diverse range of high-impact work across four main pillars:

  1. M&A and financing transactions

You will lead M&A transactions (health tech companies, software bricks, insurance groups, etc.) and financing rounds from LOI to closing, hand in hand with business owners and company leadership.

This will involve:

  • Structuring deals independently;

  • Drafting and negotiating LOIs, SPAs, SHAs and ancillary documents pragmatically, ensuring velocity and a constructive long term relationship-building with the stakeholders;

  • Running legal due diligence and resolving deal-breaking issues.

  1. Corporate structuring of strategic launches

You will lead the legal aspects of corporate structuring and contribute to defining the regulatory pathway of new business lines (e.g. insurance subsidiaries, health services) and of our international expansion.

This will involve:

  • Designing set-ups that are both legally sound and business-enabling, in close partnership with Regulatory and Product teammates;

  • Digging into tax constraints with Finance teammates;

  • Leading group structuring (also as part of M&A integration projects) and local entity set-ups, and coordinating the teams involved.

  1. Corporate governance and ESOP

You will help run and scale top-class governance operations, in close partnership with Corporate Operations, Finance and other Legal teammates.

This will involve:

  • Drafting Board resolutions and corporate documentation, and making the call on shareholder rights and corporate law questions;

  • Designing equity solutions that are compliant and attractive across countries, so every Alaner can share in Alan's success.

  1. Legal autonomy, external counsel management and automation

You will systematically increase Alan's legal autonomy, including by:

  • Building the frameworks, templates and playbooks (M&A, equity, governance) and supporting the development of automations that scale legal operations, to further reduce our reliance on external counsel and allow scalable distributed ownership internally;

  • Using external counsel as brainstorming partners, not an outsourcing solution: you form your own view first, then brief them with a precise question and proposed solution to stress-test, or to bring the local-law and market-practice expertise we lack. You own the analysis and the decision. You have the full business and operational context, they don't. This makes us faster, more cost-effective and sharper;

  • Owning the call on what we handle in-house vs. send outside, and standing behind it with a clear risk assessment and a smartly frugal mindset;

  • Partnering with Finance on the legal side of complex international tax questions.

In summary, we're looking for someone who leads complex corporate projects end to end, with high technical standards to support a genuine pragmatic, challenger mindset, and who turns every project into reusable know-how for the team.

You will work as part of the Governance Area: a group where legal experts collaborate closely with strategists (called “Corporate Operations”) to orchestrate equity programs, governance operations, and strategic initiatives. Through mentorship and mutual challenge, all members of the Governance Area push each other to venture outside their primary expertise to drive stronger, faster and more holistic governance outcomes.

At Alan, roles evolve and expand beyond their initial scope. You'll be empowered to take on new challenges across multiple domains (product bets, compliance, public affairs), building a unique path that directly impacts the future of healthcare.

Key outcomes after six months

By the end of the first six months, successful onboarding would, for example, mean for you to have:

  • Taken ownership of at least one major workstream (an M&A deal, a restructuring, the legal framework of an international expansion or of a strategic product launch) from start to finish, with autonomy, velocity and high-quality drafting;

  • Led external counsel as sparring partners on at least one workstream, owning the final position and delivering cost-effective outcomes;

  • Become a trusted, responsive legal partner for Corporate Operations, Finance, Product and People, giving practical solutions rather than theoretical answers;

  • Built or upgraded at least one template or framework that increases our legal autonomy (e.g. M&A playbook, equity documentation for a new jurisdiction);

  • Ramped up on Alan's written and async work methodology, and on our culture of transparency, accountability and distributed decision-making.

Profile & competencies

Skills

  • Experience: 5 to 10 years of corporate, M&A and/or tax law practice in an international environment, with at least 3 years in a top international law firm.

  • Technical excellence: strong expertise in corporate and M&A law, with the appetite to build transversal skills across equity, governance and tax.

  • Language: mastery of legal writing in English (French is a bonus).

  • Project leadership: has already led complex, multi-party projects (M&A, restructuring, financing) with real ownership, not only a contributor role.

Behavioural traits

  • Drive and energy: operational, hands-on, takes initiative, thrives in a fast-paced environment and gets things done.

  • Creative and pragmatic: a challenger mindset, willing to design new corporate law solutions and take calculated risks, while focusing on simplification and on what really creates value.

  • Rigor: attention to detail and focus on excellence.

  • Intellectual curiosity: eager to become an expert on topics you know less about.

  • Missionary mindset: passion for an ambitious project with highly engaged teammates, hands-on (not about the title).

  • Automation enthusiast: interest in using technology, no-code and AI to streamline legal processes and scale the team's impact.
